findings: The protocol specifies a share of market sessions; the implementation removes nonfinite ranks before computing the denominator.
A nonempty partial interval can produce the primary feature even when the signal-date rank is missing.
Therefore reported feature coverage and acceptance gates do not establish acceptance or falsification of the registered mechanism.
